from collections import deque
def get_blocks(frame):
    lines = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    grid=[list(l) for l in lines]
    r0,c0=15,15; N=12
    blocks={}
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            r=r0+3*i; c=c0+3*j
            cells=set(grid[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in range(3) for dc in range(3))
            if cells<={'b','c'}: ch='P'
            elif cells=={'N'}: ch='T'
            elif len(cells)==1: ch=cells.pop()
            else: ch='?'
            blocks[(i,j)]=ch
    return blocks
def player_pos(blocks):
    for k,v in blocks.items():
        if v=='P': return k
    return None
b=get_blocks(current_frame); p=player_pos(b)
print('player at', p)
for i in range(12):
    print(''.join(b[(i,j)] for j in range(12)))
floor=lambda ch: ch in 'WgPT'
goal=(10,10)
prev={p:None}; q=deque([p])
while q:
    cur=q.popleft()
    if cur==goal: break
    i,j=cur
    for di,dj,name in ((2,0,'DOWN'),(-2,0,'UP'),(0,2,'RIGHT'),(0,-2,'LEFT')):
        ni,nj=i+di,j+dj; mi,mj=i+di//2,j+dj//2
        if not(0<=ni<12 and 0<=nj<12): continue
        if not floor(b[(ni,nj)]) or not floor(b[(mi,mj)]): continue
        if (ni,nj) not in prev:
            prev[(ni,nj)]=(cur,name); q.append((ni,nj))
if goal in prev:
    seq=[]; cur=goal
    while cur!=p:
        cur,name=prev[cur]; seq.append(name)
    seq=seq[::-1]
    print('strict path len', len(seq), seq)
    action(seq)
    b2=get_blocks(current_frame); p2=player_pos(b2)
    print('final player at', p2, '| at target:', p2==goal)
    print('level_completed:', last_action_result.get('level_completed'),
          'done:', last_action_result.get('done'),
          'run_complete:', last_action_result.get('run_complete'),
          'game_over:', last_action_result.get('game_over'))
else:
    print('NO strict path from', p)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
